notes: How an Osa battery lays out its area at a position (simcore/campaign/battery_area.hpp): the launchers in two pairs across the threat's direction, each TZM behind its pair, the PU-12M behind the pairs with its aiming circle ahead of it, a launcher's aiming circle ahead of it, the maintenance vehicle and the camp behind the post, a reserve position. Each rule: the value the planner aims for and the bounds a place must keep. The jobs: the hours of position work and the wire's laying rate.
source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 232-239 and 249-250; ru_pu12_text; sam3d estimates where a rule says so

pair_internal_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p234, p237 (at least 200 m within a pair, up to 500 m); the value sam3d's

pair_separation_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p234-237 (pairs up to 3 km apart, so their zones overlap); the value and the least sam3d's

tzm_from_pair_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 p234 (the TZM crews within 500 m of the launchers); the value sam3d's

command_post_behind_m.source: estimate after voenizdat_osa_1991 p234, p237 (the command post at the centre of the battle order or near a pair, at a distance that keeps control steady); as data/command/battery_tactics.json

aiming_circle_post_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 249-250 (the PU-12M's aiming circle 30-40 m from it)

aiming_circle_launcher_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 249-250 (a launcher's aiming circle 20-50 m from it)

reserve_within_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 232-239 (a reserve position within 2 km); the value and the least sam3d's

maintenance_behind_m.source: sam3d estimate (G0: the maintenance vehicle serves the four launchers, voenizdat_osa_1991 p189; its place not given)

camp_behind_m.source: sam3d estimate (G0: the camp's place, pvo_bu_ix_1984, to be read)

clear_m.source: voenizdat_osa_1991 pp. 232-239 (nothing tall within 20 m of a launcher)

dig_emplacement_h.source: sam3d estimate (G0: an emplacement for a 9A33 dug by an engineer machine; the norm to be found)

nets_h.source: sam3d estimate (G0: camouflage nets over a vehicle by its crew)

wire_lay_mps.source: ru_pu12_text (the P-274 field cable: four lines of 500 m in 25-30 min, 2 km in about 27 min)
